x: A further invitation having been given by the Union Sportive Metropolitaine for us to compete in the above event was accepted and the following team was chosen to represent the Club---Carter, Cohen, Footer, D. Patience, J. Parker, Penny, Tobin and Verney, accompanied by W.G.
Gerry North's 4th came close to beating the latter record at Dublin and, in time, he should beat the former too. Belgrave appearances for the other home countries were:- J.
Unlike the 1 mile championship, he wisely let J.Parker go and worked up to his man gradually. When he did catch his rival he soon went in front, and Pat was well beaten long before the finish.

Not being able to turn out our best team, in fact 6 were unavailable, did not help and we finished 2nd again. Boys 2kms; 6.D.McGroder 12.11; 10.J.Parker 14.18; 11.P.Whiston 14.41. Senior 5kms; 3.R.Dorman 21.44; 4.C.Lawton 23.42;
